info.title: FUTABUS HTTP API
info.description: Current public HTTP API. Booking and account pages use web routes and are not represented as REST endpoints. The SePay webhook is called by SePay, not by customers.

post.summary: Receive a SePay bank transfer event
post.description: SePay calls this endpoint. Authentication mode is selected by server configuration: HMAC-SHA256 or API key. A successful HTTP response acknowledges receipt; it does not guarantee a booking was issued. Duplicate and unmatched transactions are handled by payment processing. Do not send test payments to a production account.

parameters.name: X-SePay-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, accepted within five minutes when HMAC mode is active.

parameters.name: X-SePay-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + '.' + raw request body, prefixed with sha256=, when HMAC mode is active.

get.summary: Read staff activity calendar and actionable request queue
get.description: Read-only company-scoped activity for active, verified staff. Bearer tokens require the api ability. Metrics follow per-domain permissions and are null when inaccessible. Exchange replacements are excluded from newly issued tickets. Pending counts use request creation dates and current unfinished status. Queue entries are unassigned or assigned to the current employee, ordered oldest first. Missing company scope returns no accessible metrics or queue entries. Limit: 60 requests per minute.

parameters.description: Calendar month; defaults to the current month in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

get.summary: List issued tickets within the operator company
get.description: Requires active verified staff/operator and ticket.view. Checks trip, route and bus company ownership. Lists real tickets newest first, 15 per page. Server-time checks derive display_status and usable; active tickets at or past departure display expired. Stored status is unchanged. No-store response contains passenger data only within the authorized company.

post.summary: Confirm cash received at the staff counter and issue tickets
post.description: Requires active verified staff/operator, booking.create, company scope, and the initiating browser session draft. X-CSRF-TOKEN is required for session mutations. The server calculates the amount and rechecks both trip legs, fares, departure and seat holds inside one transaction. Repeated confirmations return the same receipt. No SePay transaction is fabricated; a superseded pending bank intent is expired. Late bank transfers require reconciliation through the existing webhook. Cash receipts store operator/company audit metadata in payments.payload.

200.description: Completed cash receipt and issued tickets in data, including staff receipt HTML
